original_test_intent: Create EventService behavior through a temporary subscription and observe an event, while the preserved Procedure only inventories subscriptions.
original_method: After acknowledging the source mismatch, establish an isolated listener, capture subscription baseline, approve and create one least-scope temporary subscription, generate one controlled event, correlate its receipt, delete the subscription and verify baseline restoration.
manual_activity: Resolve GET-only Procedure versus create/delivery intent; approve the isolated listener, TLS/authentication, minimum event scope, safe event stimulus, retention and cleanup lifecycle.
required_inputs: Listener TLS certificate and authentication contract
safety_requirements: No hardcoded secrets or TLS bypass
Do not default to broad Alert scope
Create exactly one uniquely identifiable subscription
Send only an approved synthetic event
Redact event payload and destination secrets
Do not leave residual listener data or subscription state
agent_execution_scope: Validate isolated listener reachability, TLS and ownership
Correlate one listener receipt by context/time/type

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: POSTing a subscription better fits the likely intent than the Master GET, but it materially expands source behavior; broad Alert scope, arbitrary destination, no actual stimulus, no DELETE command and insecure transport cannot prove safe delivery lifecycle.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Create one schema-valid least-scope subscription to a verified isolated listener, correlate one approved synthetic event, then delete the returned resource and prove both BMC subscription and listener evidence return to the approved final state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The EventService subscription area and 15/10 timing remain; destination, protocol, event type, stimulus, payload, retry window and cleanup identity are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the row as an atomic notification-path lifecycle with explicit data-flow authorization, unique subscription identity, controlled stimulus, receipt correlation and cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the GET/create mismatch explicit and supplies the missing external listener, safe stimulus, delivery oracle, unique cleanup and data-retention controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Covers one event type and one listener transaction only; it does not validate every event format, retry/failover policy, production receiver or high-volume delivery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Even a test subscription can expose operational metadata or remain persistent; listener receipt without correlation may be an unrelated event and must not be counted.

project_override_considerations: If the target exposes SubmitTestEvent or another safe action, use its approved schema; otherwise select a non-disruptive allow-listed stimulus. Never induce a hardware fault or clear logs merely to generate an event.
expected_evidence: Minimum event type and safe stimulus
Unchanged unrelated subscriptions and preserved logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Script require EventService creation behavior, but the Master Procedure only GETs existing subscriptions. Inventory readability cannot create a subscription or deliver an event, so the method and coverage conflict is material.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The subscription schema, listener, event stimulus, approvals and cleanup are concrete project inputs, making the review REQUIRES rather than irreducibly BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Prevents a read-only list or incomplete broad subscription from passing a create-event case, and constrains the real test to a traceable, least-scope and fully removed external data path.
independent_technical_reasoning: Creating a subscription and creating an event are different operations. A subscription establishes a persistent outbound route; delivery still needs a known stimulus and a correlation field or timestamp window proving the received payload came from this test. Because the destination leaves the BMC trust boundary, listener ownership, transport trust and data minimization are security prerequisites. Cleanup must use the exact Location/resource returned by the POST so an existing subscription is never deleted by guessed ID.
